champion.tips: LEE SIN TIPS AND TRICKS Just because you landed your Q on the enemy, it doesn’t mean you have to follow up and go in! Using your Flash in conjunction with your Ultimate R to kick a squishy carry into your team could be a great way of winning a team fight. Keeping the minion wave slightly closer to your side of the map in the early parts of the game could offer you more trading opportunities.
champion.builds: THE BEST LEE SIN BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR TOP IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Lee Sin Top build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Conqueror as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, as well as Sudden Impact and Treasure Hunter in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Ravenous Hydra as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Eclipse. For your last 3 items, you should build Sundered Sky, Black Cleaver and finish with Guardian Angel. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 46.7% winrate over 443 matches played. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Cosmic Insight with Magical Footwear in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Ravenous Hydra as your first item, then Plated Steelcaps as a second item and Black Cleaver as a third item. You want to finish the build with Death's Dance, Sundered Sky and Guardian Angel. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - W - E. This build is currently sitting at a 43.4% win rate across 219 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Lee Sin Top build in the current patch, try Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, Conqueror, Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand as your primary rune tree, and Bone Plating with Demolish as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Profane Hydra as your first item, then finish Plated Steelcaps as your second item, and Eclipse as third item. The last 3 options are Black Cleaver, Guardian Angel and Dead Man's Plate. The ability order for this build is Q - W - E. As of the current patch, this build has a 53.6% win rate over 56 matches played. Situational Lee Sin Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Lee Sin build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Lee Sin runes page.
